_meta.research_notes: Platform-native precleared music: the infrastructure that lets an ad carry a REAL song with zero clearance work, because the platform already licensed it. TikTok's Commercial Music Library (~1M tracks incl. commercial releases; mandatory for business accounts; free for organic posts AND Spark Ads amplifying your own video; filterable by placement/theme/genre/mood/duration in Creative Center). Meta's Sound Collection (14k+ tracks licensed for FB/IG content including ads) plus Meta's licensed-music rollout for Reels ads in Ads Manager / Advantage+ creative, including auto 'music optimization' where Meta picks the track. The Sonic Segments fit: our separation stack already isolates the voiceover, so we ship ONE music-free master + one platform-library sound pick per audience leaf — the platform supplies and streams the licensed song, we supply the intelligence of WHICH song fits WHICH audience. Hard limits encoded below: mainstream licensed catalog (what personal creator accounts hear) is NOT usable in standard paid ads on either platform — the ad-safe paths are exactly CML and Meta's ad-cleared libraries, and library music is placement-restricted (e.g. Meta music currently on Reels/carousel placements).

libraries.label: TikTok Commercial Music Library
libraries.catalog: ~1M pre-cleared tracks, including real commercial releases (Anthem/5 Alarm and other licensed catalogs)
cleared_for: auction ads where the sound is marked ad-usable
libraries.not_cleared: General/trending sounds (the personal-account catalog) are NOT usable by business accounts or in paid promotion.
libraries.browse: TikTok Creative Center → Commercial Music Library (publicly browsable; per-track 'usable placements' flags)

launch_paths.label: Spark Ads variant blast
launch_paths.how: Post N organic videos from the brand/creator account — same footage (our clean master), each with a different CML sound picked per audience leaf — then create one Spark Ad per post, each ad group targeted to its leaf (geo + age + interest). The sound rides natively; no clearance, no re-render.
launch_paths.fit: This is the 'hundreds of the same reel with different sounds' mechanic, entirely inside existing TikTok infrastructure.

launch_paths.label: Ads Manager + commercial sound
launch_paths.how: Upload the clean master as ad video and attach a CML track flagged usable for the ad placement.

libraries.label: Meta Sound Collection + Reels-ads licensed music
libraries.catalog: Sound Collection: 14k+ tracks/SFX licensed for Facebook+Instagram content including ads; plus Meta's licensed library for music on Reels ads in Ads Manager
cleared_for: Reels ads via Ads Manager music feature / Advantage+ creative (placement-limited rollout)
libraries.not_cleared: The mainstream licensed catalog personal accounts use on organic Reels is NOT cleared for standard paid ads; Sound Collection tracks are cleared for FB/IG only (not other platforms).
libraries.browse: Meta Business Suite → Sound Collection; Ads Manager Creative Editor → Add music

launch_paths.label: Reels ads with library music
launch_paths.how: Upload the clean master, attach a library track per ad in Ads Manager (or let Advantage+ 'music optimization' auto-pick); one ad set per audience leaf carries its own track choice.
launch_paths.fit: Meta will even auto-select music — our layer replaces 'auto' with an audience-reasoned pick per leaf.

launch_paths.label: Partnership (creator) ads
launch_paths.how: Creator posts the branded Reel with permitted music, brand boosts via partnership ads; music eligibility follows the sound's ad-usability flag.
